brief.claim: In a cohort of patients, a linear regression of the clinical outcome score on the first 10 principal components of the biomarker panel predicts the outcome of new patients with an R-squared of at least 0.15, estimated by 5-fold cross-validation.

data_keys.meaning: baseline blood biomarker concentrations (log scale) measured on each patient
clinical outcome score of each patient at 12-month follow-up
